history.summary: A 1,109 sqft freehold 4BR at Blossom Mansions (D14 Paya Lebar, 1995) at $1.48M / $1,335 PSF, right at the $1,330 reference median and 630m from Paya Lebar MRT interchange. Fairly priced and well-located, but only 1 URA txn and a small 1995 development limit conviction.
history.rating_rationale: $1,335 PSF essentially matches the $1,330 median (no overpricing), and $1.48M for a freehold 1,109 sqft 4BR near the Paya Lebar EWL/CCL interchange is a liquid, attractive quantum with a genuine Paya Lebar Central catalyst. But only 1 URA transaction means appreciation is unverifiable, and a small 1995 (31-yr) mansion block has shallow resale liquidity. Good location and fair price offset by thin data and age — a balanced Neutral leaning constructive.
red_flags: 1995 build (31 yrs) — aging block, maintenance risk
Small boutique mansion development — limited resale liquidity
catalysts: 630m to Paya Lebar EWL/CCL interchange — dual-line transit
